configurePresets.name: tests
configurePresets.description: Smoke + contract suites against the public C ABI; no Python bindings. Mirrors the blocking CI leg (contract-tests.yml).

configurePresets.name: tests-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug leg of contract-tests.yml: the dlopen-failure plugin pin is build-mode dependent (issue #32), so CI runs both modes.

configurePresets.name: sanitize
configurePresets.description: AL_CONTRACT_SANITIZE=ON instruments libal and contract_tests (TEST_STRATEGY.md D7). Mirrors sanitizers.yml. Never combine with a wheel build: the bindings would link a sanitized libal without the ASan runtime.

configurePresets.name: mdsplus
configurePresets.displayName: MDSplus test build (bakes the DD model tree)
configurePresets.description: MDSplus backend + baked model tree + tests. Pass -DDD_VERSION=<tag> to pin the DD (models/mdsplus defaults to 'main'; mdsplus-contract.yml pins its own). Downloads the DD at configure time.

configurePresets.name: benchmarks
configurePresets.description: Google Benchmark harness in benchmarks/ (issue #52); independent of AL_BUILD_TESTS and off in the ordinary build. A benchmark 'failing' means slower, not wrong, so this never gates the correctness suite.
